rationale: CROSS-EDUCATOR, on WHY price spikes beyond a level before reversing. TJR attributes it to market makers deliberately filling large positions against retail stops. RAYNER_TEO treats the same phenomenon as ordinary volatility to be absorbed with an ATR buffer, offering no intent-based explanation at all. Filed MINOR because the two are not logically incompatible - one is a mechanism claim and the other declines to make one - but it is recorded because it is the THIRD position the library now holds on this phenomenon, after ALEX_G called the institutional explanation 'almost a big hoax' (XCONTRA|20260728|002). Rayner's treatment is the only one that yields a usable parameter without settling the mechanism.
